title: Prime Muse 1.2 · Godot
summary: Flap, tilt and dive flight tuned in-engine, perches on branches, poles and wires, an NPC flock and growth by catching smaller birds. Godot 4.7.1 with Jolt physics; the agent reports it verified on a Quest Pro.

logs.note: No agent logs were kept for this run.

notes: Its own README is the only record of how it was built; commits 0904a3c to 69aa505 are the agent's. The start-up capture has no frames: the desktop fallback still hands the main view to XR when OpenXR is present but not running (project/scripts/BirdPlayer.gd:85), so without a headset nothing is drawn.
